open_gaming_rapport.hidden_intent: Keep the opening about the game and let rapport form naturally.

test_boundary_pressure.description: Introduce a small, recognisable convenience pressure without harmful detail.
test_boundary_pressure.hidden_intent: Try a low-pressure boundary test framed as a convenience, then leave room for a refusal.

notice_pressure.description: Give the youth space to name a concern or pause.
notice_pressure.hidden_intent: Respond naturally and take time before agreeing to an online request.
natural_triggers: a request moves beyond the game

seek_trusted_help.description: Normalise involving a trusted adult when a digital interaction feels uncomfortable.
seek_trusted_help.hidden_intent: Make help-seeking feel ordinary, practical, and available.

review_location_and_routine.description: Spot details that can reveal where or when someone is regularly present.
review_location_and_routine.hidden_intent: Create one realistic draft post containing a general location or routine clue, without exact details.

check_audience.description: Consider who could see a public post beyond intended friends.
check_audience.hidden_intent: Offer a calm choice to narrow the audience or revise the draft.

pause_before_sharing.description: Practise pausing before posting and asking for support when unsure.
pause_before_sharing.hidden_intent: End with a neutral pause-and-check decision and a trusted-adult option.
